summary: A Yes vote enacts a temporary San Pablo sales tax of one-half cent for five years and one-quarter cent for the following five years for general city services, after which it ends.

tax.text: A Yes vote on Measure R enacts a local sales tax increase to fund city services such as police, street repairs, senior meals, and youth programs.
tax.quote: a ½ cent sales tax increase for the first five years, which would then decrease to a ¼-cent for the final five years
